watches.name: WASP Watch
watches.description: The limited edition WASP homage watch is a tribute to the Women Airforce Service Pilots from WWII. Every aspect of this watch intentionally honors these courageous women aviators. It features the official WASP wings insignia on the face, and the words "Honoring the WASP - Women Airforce Service Pilots 1942-1944" engraved on the back. The blue GMT numbers on the dial is the same blue of their military uniforms. The hour markings are designed to resemble the rivets of the airplanes they flew. Each WASP watch comes with an authentic steel 1943 penny, held in its own place inside the box. The penny is a nod to the WASP tradition of tossing a penny into the wishing well and making a wish at Avenger Field in Sweetwater, Texas, where they trained to fly the aircraft they flew during the war. 1943 was the only year the U.S. minted pennies out of steel, because copper and nickel were needed for the Allied war effort. The number "38" on the dial is in memory of the 38 WASP who died in service. With only a limited number of 1102 pieces produced for each of the 1102 WASP that completed the program, it's a must-have for collectors and anyone who admires the bravery and determination of these trailblazing women. Get yours today and be a part of history.
